workflowName: COPD chronic bronchitis — PDE4B 50 phytochemicals + roflumilast

inputs.name: Receptor
inputs.description: Protein receptor to dock the small-molecule ligands against (the target for vina, gnina, diffdock, sigmadock, smina, pandadock, surfdock, flowdock, dynamicbind).
inputs.tooltip: Protein receptor to dock the small-molecule ligands against (the target for vina, gnina, diffdock, sigmadock, smina, pandadock, surfdock, flowdock, dynamicbind).

inputs.name: Compounds
inputs.description: Small-molecule ligands to dock against the receptor (at least one). Every docking model requires this — the adapters raise in prepare() on an empty list.
inputs.tooltip: Small-molecule ligands to dock against the receptor (at least one). Every docking model requires this — the adapters raise in prepare() on an empty list.

inputs.name: Pocket
inputs.description: Predicted binding pocket(s) used to focus the docking search box. Optional — when omitted, each model falls back to its config-specified box (manual center/size) or runs blind docking (flowdock, dynamicbind, surfdock).
inputs.tooltip: Predicted binding pocket(s) used to focus the docking search box. Optional — when omitted, each model falls back to its config-specified box (manual center/size) or runs blind docking (flowdock, dynamicbind, surfdock).
